overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Trustees' 2016 meeting notices were posted, and the website migration only created uncertainty. A later notice-detail allegation was not reviewed because it was not in the original complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Trustees failed to post notice of meetings held between January and November 2016, after the town moved its notices to a new website system.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Trustees' meeting notices were indeed posted in accordance with the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant later asserted that topics listed on certain meeting notices lacked sufficient detail, but this was not in the original complaint filed with the Trustees.
allegations.key_passage: Because this allegation was not included in the complaint filed with the Trustees, we do not address it now.
